name: higgsfield-cinematic-workflow
description: Full cinematic AI video production pipeline — mood board → hero frame → Cinema Studio → edit. Higgsfield AI + Nano Banana Pro + Kling 2.6 + Google V3.1.

steps.name: Step 1 — Creative Brief
steps.description: Extract subject, setting, emotion, platform, style from rough idea

steps.name: Step 2 — Mood Board Keywords
steps.description: Generate Pinterest/reference search keywords for visual inspiration

steps.name: Step 3 — Hero Frame Prompt
steps.description: Generate Nano Banana Pro image prompt for hero frame. Formula: Subject + Setting + Cinematic Lighting + Composition (rule of thirds) + Depth (FG/MG/BG) + Color Grade
steps.prompt_formula: [SUBJECT] [SETTING/ENVIRONMENT] cinematic lighting from [DIRECTION] casting [SHADOW_TYPE]. Subject positioned [COMPOSITION]. Foreground: [FG_ELEMENT]. Background: [BG_ELEMENT]. [COLOR_GRADE] color grade. Photorealistic. No motion blur. No text on clothing.

steps.name: Step 4 — Shot Sequence Selection
steps.description: Select best 5-8 camera movements from 29-shot library based on style and emotion

steps.name: Step 5 — Video Prompts (Cinema Studio)
steps.description: Adapt shot library prompts to specific subject. Formula: Camera Movement + Subject Action + Environment + Lighting + Audio Directive

audio_rules.kling-2.6: Always specify audio: 'ambient [type] sound' or 'no dialogue'
audio_rules.google-v3.1: Always specify: 'no dialogue' or exact dialogue text

steps.name: Step 6 — Soul ID Character Sheet (optional)
steps.description: Generate 20 Nano Banana prompts for Soul ID training — front/side/back/expressions/full body
soul_id_shots: Front view, looking at camera, neutral expression, solid background
Front view, serious expression, solid background
Left side profile, looking left, solid background
Right side profile, looking right, solid background
Close-up face, looking at camera, slight smile
Full body front, arms at sides
Full body, walking away from camera

steps.name: Step 7 — Edit Timeline Guide
steps.description: Generate editing sequence: clip order, cut points, overlay suggestions, speed ramps
editing_techniques: Import + arrange clips in story order
Quick cuts: trim AI generation artifacts from start/end
Luma key overlay: add cinematic depth layers
Speed ramp: slow entry → normal → slow exit for key moments
Color grade: match hero frame palette across all clips
